summary: Tested Autorización de Compras (Purchase Authorization) Phase 1 module. All 11 backend tests passed. Frontend UI is fully functional with navigation, server/sucursal/almacen selection, calculation, KPIs display, inventory info, and results table with all required columns.

minor.issue: Returns duplicate almacenes when filtering by sucursal name instead of ID. Query uses Sc_Cve_Sucursal = '{sucursal_id}' but frontend passes sucursal name like 'ORIGEN'

ui_bugs.issue: Shows repeated text like 'ALMACEN GENERALALMACEN GENERALALMACEN G...' due to duplicate entries from backend

action_items: Consider adding DISTINCT to almacenes query or fixing the sucursal parameter handling to use ID instead of name
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing ManagmentPro server data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Compras module Phase 1 is fully functional. The endpoint /api/compras/calculo-pedido works correctly for MPRO servers. SoftRestaurant returns 501 (in development). Key features: 1) Server/Sucursal/Almacen selection cascade works. 2) KPIs calculate correctly (total products, products to order, total cost, low stock, no physical inventory). 3) Inventory info shows folio and date. 4) Table shows all 12 required columns. 5) Products without physical inventory show 'Ingresar' button for manual entry. Minor issue: almacenes endpoint returns duplicates due to sucursal name vs ID mismatch.

server_selection_mpro.details: ManagmentPro (MPRO) server can be selected and loads sucursales

sucursal_selection.details: Sucursales load after server selection, ORIGEN available

almacen_selection.details: Almacenes load after sucursal selection, BODEGA and ALMACEN GENERAL available

calculo_pedido_endpoint.details: POST /api/compras/calculo-pedido returns correct data structure with all required fields

kpis_display.details: 5 KPIs displayed: Total Productos, Productos a Pedir, Costo Total Pedido, Stock Bajo (<3 días), Sin Inv. Físico

inventory_info_display.details: Shows folio and date of physical inventory, BODEGA badge when applicable

table_columns.details: All 12 columns present: Código, Producto, Familia, Inv. Físico, Compras, Consumos, Inv. Teórico, Prom. Diario, Días Inv., Consumo Esp., Cant. Pedir, Costo Pedido

manual_entry_for_no_inventory.details: Products without physical inventory show 'Ingresar' button with edit icon

api_tests.GET /api/servers/{id}/sucursales: PASS - Returns sucursales for MPRO server
api_tests.POST /api/compras/calculo-pedido: PASS - Returns calculation with all required fields
